entities.summary: David Zakharyevich Sarajishvili (Georgian: დავით ზაქარიას ძე სარაჯიშვილი; was a Georgian scientist, entrepreneur and philanthropist. Founder of several brandy plants in the Russian Empire, including the Tbilisi and Kizlyar Brandy Factory.
